notes.title: FMVMachine 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
This update introduces new functionality as well as UI/UX improvements. They are as follows:

[list]
[*] Added a language select button that allows users to change the language of the app. The current available choices are English (Default), Chinese, Korean, and Spanish. Please message me at support@fmvmachine.com if there is a language you'd like to see added in a future update.

[*] Changed the styling of the top menu buttons to make them more responsive to different resolutions.

[*] Revised the top menu to only show the edit/playback toggle button when in playback mode and show all buttons only when in edit mode. This is to make it more clear which mode the user is in.

[*] Revised the hotspot creation and edit menu to allow users to name their hotspots. Now the hotspots in the hotspot list will show the hotspot by the name input into the name field. This is to allow users to know exactly which hotspot is which in the list and allow for better project flow.
[/list]

If there are any other updates that you would like to see added in future updates, please message me at support@fmvmachine.com
